title: USG-UAP-D001, Congressional, White House, UFO-related Constituent Correspondence, 1998
what_is_it: A collection of draft and final correspondence from the White House and Congressional offices responding to constituent inquiries about UFOs, dating primarily from 1998.
interpretation_warnings: No extracted body text available — all facts derived from document metadata and CSV description only.
The PDF appears to be scanned with poor or no OCR, so specific names, dates, and verbatim quotes from the letters themselves could not be captured.
Source quotes are empty throughout because no body text was extractable.
The document reflects the official U.S. Government position as of 1998, which has since evolved significantly with the establishment of AARO and congressional UAP hearings.
